title: Model floor by verifiability: judgment stays frontier, execution runs cheap
subject: model-floor-verifiability
ratio: The model-tier partition is by verifiability. Low-verifiability judgment work - goal decomposition, DAG design, join synthesis, direction - stays frontier, and the orchestration-planner stays opus. High-verifiability execution work - code gated by tests, audits with replayable evidence, page-cited corpus reading - runs sonnet, with quality protected by producer-not-approver adversarial replay, not by model tier. Haiku is only for bounded mechanical tasks, never long-horizon or strategic work.
dicta: Tier 2 on P-020 and P-030: the floor entered in the P-020 cost_policy block and was re-amended by P-030 per the operator ontology (frontier orchestrates, plans and directs; the cheap tier executes). The fullest single statement lives at state.json cost_policy.rules entry 7, including the haiku evidence citation; ORCHESTRATION.md:149-161 is the contract-prose restatement and primary home (CD1). Recorded census correction (ledger OPEN-QUESTION 3): the scout census and T-388 criterion 10 called rule 7 a state.json-only orphan; the live read found the ORCHESTRATION.md restatement, so the row moved to wave 1 and rule 7 is subsumed by this record. Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-16.
